advisories.title: Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Monitoring Expert
advisories.summary: Successful exploitation could allow remote code execution or DoS. Affects EcoStruxure Power Monitoring Expert versions prior to 2021 SP1.

advisories.title: Schneider Electric Modicon M340 PLC Authentication Bypass
advisories.summary: Modicon M340, Momentum, and MC80 PLCs contain authentication bypass via Modbus protocol on port 502. Attacker with network access can gain unauthorized write access to PLC registers.

advisories.title: Rockwell Automation FactoryTalk View SE RCE
advisories.summary: FactoryTalk View SE is vulnerable to RCE. A threat actor with network access could execute arbitrary code on HMI workstations at Purdue Level 2.

advisories.title: Rockwell Allen-Bradley 1756 ControlLogix Vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities in Allen-Bradley 1756 ControlLogix allow authenticated user to execute malicious code on the device via EtherNet/IP protocol.

advisories.title: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1200 and S7-1500 CPU Denial of Service
advisories.summary: Siemens S7-1200 and S7-1500 PLCs contain improper input validation. Exploitation causes denial-of-service via crafted S7 protocol packets.

advisories.title: Siemens SCALANCE Network Devices Path Traversal
advisories.summary: Siemens SCALANCE industrial switches contain path traversal allowing authenticated remote attacker to read arbitrary files from device filesystem.
